company_type: IIT Madras spinoff, early-stage green hydrogen electrolyser startup

technology.sub_domain: Chemical Processing (electrolytic H2) — Industrial decarbonisation use
technology.description: Newtrace was founded in 2022 by Rochan & Prasanta, originating in Dr. Satya Chakrvarthy's lab at IIT Madras. The team redesigned a green-hydrogen electrolyser from first principles using a membrane-less stack architecture manufactured via 3D printing. The membrane-less + automated-manufacturing + modular-stack approach reduces manufacturing cost by more than 30% vs conventional alkaline / PEM electrolysers.
technology.problem_solved: Conventional electrolysers depend on expensive membranes (PEM) or scarce catalysts (alkaline). Newtrace's design eliminates the membrane and uses 3D printing to lower part count and capex.
technology.innovation_summary: Membrane-less architecture is the key novelty; 3D-printed stack reduces capex; modular design enables scaling without redesign.
technology.unique_selling_points: First-principles engineering origin; IIT Madras lab pedigree; first paying customer within 1 year of pre-seed; seed funding from Sequoia + Speciale + Micelio + Aavishkar
technology.application_area: Hard-to-abate industrial decarbonisation: cement, steel, fertilizer, refining
technology.target_industries: Cement majors, steel mills, fertiliser companies, refiners with on-site H2 needs
technology.potential_customers: Two large energy utilities already signed (per investor disclosure); cement and steel pilots planned
technology.mrl_level: 4–5 (Capability demonstrated on prototypes; not yet full-rate production)
technology.patent_status: Filed (early-stage patent portfolio); per Speciale Invest: 'patented electrolyser technology'
technology.institution_name: IIT Madras (Dr. Satya Chakrvarthy's lab origin)
technology.wipo_green_listed: Strong eligibility (electrolyser is core WIPO Green category)
technology.estimated_market_size: Indian green hydrogen mission target: 5 MMT/year by 2030; electrolyser capex market ~₹50,000 Cr
technology.preferred_license_type: Patent Buyout (territorial / industry exclusivity) — high IP-value
technology.certification_status: PESO clearance pathway (H2 handling); pursuing ISO 9001
